ALL THAT the residential flat being Flat No. 8, situated on the Fourth Floor, in the residential apartment building constructed on Plot No. 1A, Hauz Khas Enclave, within the revenue estate of Village Hauz Khas, in the area of New Delhi Municipal Council (NDMC), in the National Capital Territory of Delhi, New Delhi - 110016, admeasuring 1200 sq.ft. (One Thousand Two Hundred Square Feet) of super built-up area and 950 sq.ft. (Nine Hundred and Fifty Square Feet) of carpet area, and bounded as follows:
On the NORTH by : Common passage / corridor
On the SOUTH by : Flat No. 9, belonging to another DDA allottee
On the EAST by : Open space / balcony overlooking the park
On the WEST by : Common staircase and lift shaft
Together with the undivided proportionate share in the common areas and facilities of the building including but not limited to the staircase, lift, lobby, parking area, water supply installation, and drainage system.
